_doc: Outside Agents received-commission ledger. Tier upgrades are per-host on commission RECEIVED (post-travel payout), trailing 12 months. OA: 80% base; 90% at $10,000; 95% at $40,000 (exact $ from OA Learn-More subpage; mechanism confirmed via Anansi from OA FAQ 2026-06-20). OA pays weekly Tuesdays after supplier pays. v1: append each weekly statement line manually (Harlan signs); v2: automate via portal-access CI tool. Each received[] entry: {date, client, booking, supplier, gross_commission_usd, d2m_received_usd, statement_ref}.
